message: En el tramo de Kennedy que estoy mirando dejó de subir el nivel, pero la calle sigue anegada. #inundacion #Bogota

attachments.alt_text: Synthetic AI-generated original image for post-0013: Horizontal candid mobile photograph looking across a quiet flooded residential street in Kennedy, Bogotá from a sheltered stoop. Standing rainwater level stable below several raised thresholds; a pale mint house with two grey doors and an orange-brick building across the way, one black motorcycle parked high on a dry tiled porch. Still water reflections, drizzle easing, no dramatic movement, no people foreground.
